pages.text: $(bold)Current workflow$()$(br2)Place a Meditation Cushion and use it with your main hand. If it is free, you enter meditation and the direct spell configuration screen opens. Keep one or more Transcend wands anywhere in your inventory; the screen discovers them automatically.

$(bold)Practical setup$()$(br)1. Carry a wand.$(br)2. Use the cushion.$(br)3. Choose Wand and Slot.$(br)4. Choose one carrier and one element.$(br)5. Add allowed effects and Save.$(br2)The server writes only a valid configured slot. Casting uses the wand's selected slot. Legacy scrolls and SpellBooks keep migration data but cannot cast independently.

$(bold)Meditation rules$()$(br2)A cushion accepts one occupant. Use the same cushion again to leave. Moving more than 3 blocks or breaking the cushion evicts the occupant. Entering another cushion clears the old seat first.$(br2)$(bold)Warning:$() This manual intentionally omits old circles, rituals, bosses, lore, and workbench recipes that are not part of this implemented workflow.
